Specification: This specification models a very small state-transition system over two variables, x and y. It defines a single action Next that constrains the next-state values of x and y through a conjunction of equalities and a nested disjunction, effectively specifying a cyclic dependency between the primed values x' and y'. The file does not declare an initial predicate, temporal specification, fairness condition, proof, or fault model; it only gives the transition relation.
